Senses.Explanation: A dog gnawing a dry bone keeps biting an object that yields no flesh or nourishment. Masters give the phrase as a curt answer or appended verdict on stale formulas, scriptural and case collections treated as objects of empty chewing, and statements that merely pursue a verbal block.
